CLASS ltcl_probe DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION MEDIUM.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv TYPE string.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_case TYPE string iv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS gen RETURNING VALUE(rv_prog) TYPE string.
    METHODS p8_pool FOR TESTING.
    METHODS p9_limit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_probe IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv = mv && iv_case && '=' && iv_value && ';'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD gen.
    DATA: lt_code TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH DEFAULT KEY,
          lv_prog TYPE c LENGTH 40,
          lv_mess TYPE string.
    APPEND `PROGRAM.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `FORM f USING p TYPE i CHANGING r TYPE i.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `  r = p * 2.` TO lt_code.
    APPEND `ENDFORM.` TO lt_code.
    GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL lt_code NAME lv_prog MESSAGE lv_mess.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_prog = lv_prog.
    ELSE.
      rv_prog = |subrc{ sy-subrc }:{ lv_mess }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p8_pool.
    DATA: lv_prog  TYPE string,
          lv_name  TYPE c LENGTH 40,
          lv_cnt   TYPE i,
          lv_r     TYPE i,
          lv_out   TYPE string.
    lv_prog = gen( ).
    lv_name = lv_prog.
    add( iv_case = 'name' iv_value = lv_prog ).
    add( iv_case = 'name length' iv_value = |{ strlen( lv_prog ) }| ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tadir INTO lv_cnt WHERE obj_name = lv_name.
    add( iv_case = 'tadir rows' iv_value = |{ lv_cnt }| ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trdir INTO lv_cnt WHERE name = lv_name.
    add( iv_case = 'trdir rows' iv_value = |{ lv_cnt }| ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reposrc INTO lv_cnt WHERE progname = lv_name.
    add( iv_case = 'reposrc rows' iv_value = |{ lv_cnt }| ).
    COMMIT WORK.
    CLEAR lv_r.
    PERFORM f IN PROGRAM (lv_name) USING 21 CHANGING lv_r IF FOUND.
    add( iv_case = 'perform after commit' iv_value = |{ lv_r }| ).
    FREE MEMORY ID 'ZOSD_ORA2'.
    SUBMIT zosd_ora2_sub WITH p_prog = lv_name AND RETURN.
    CLEAR lv_out.
    IMPORT out = lv_out FROM MEMORY ID 'ZOSD_ORA2'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_out = 'no export'.
    ENDIF.
    add( iv_case = 'second internal session' iv_value = lv_out ).
    lv_prog = gen( ).
    add( iv_case = 'second pool name' iv_value = lv_prog ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'P8' detail = mv quit = if_aunit_constants=>method ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD p9_limit.
    DATA: lv_prog TYPE string,
          lv_n    TYPE i,
          lv_last TYPE string.
    DO 1500 TIMES.
      lv_prog = gen( ).
      IF lv_prog CP 'subrc*'.
        add( iv_case = 'first failure at' iv_value = |{ sy-index }| ).
        add( iv_case = 'failure' iv_value = lv_prog ).
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lv_n = sy-index.
      lv_last = lv_prog.
    ENDDO.
    add( iv_case = 'generated' iv_value = |{ lv_n }| ).
    add( iv_case = 'last name' iv_value = lv_last ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'P9' detail = mv quit = if_aunit_constants=>method ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
